findings.claim: LastPass detected unusual activity within portions of its development environment two weeks prior to December 22, 2022, where an unauthorized party gained access through a single compromised developer account and took portions of source code and some proprietary LastPass technical information.

On June 12th, LastPass was made aware of an incident at Klue, a third-party market intelligence platform, where an unauthorized actor obtained OAuth tokens Klue held for many of its customers, including LastPass, and used these credentials to access LastPass customer data within its Salesforce environment.

The information accessed in the Klue incident was limited to standard business contact information and related customer relationship management (CRM) data, including customer names, phone numbers, email addresses, physical addresses, support case data, and sales-related data.

In August 2022, an attacker compromised the laptop of a LastPass software developer and downloaded 14 of LastPass's source code repositories, technical documentation, and an encrypted version of the SSE-C key that secured backups of LastPass's production database inside AWS S3 buckets.

In a second incident, a senior DevOps engineer's personal computer was compromised, and the attacker used a keystroke logger to obtain the employee's credentials and access an internal vault holding further keys.

LastPass acknowledged on December 22, 2022, that customer data was compromised as a result of a cyberattack, stating that an unauthorized party, using information obtained in the August 2022 incident, gained access to certain elements of their customers’ information.
In December 2022, LastPass notified their users about a security incident that put passwords stored in LastPass at risk.

findings.claim: LastPass processes personal data via equipment and resources located in the United States and other locations throughout the world.
LastPass's default location for Vault data is the United States.
LastPass utilizes Amazon Web Services via US-East-1 (Virginia) and US-East-2 (Ohio) for Vault/Customer Content hosting in the United States.
LastPass utilizes Amazon Web Services via US-East-1 (Virginia) for Unified Admin Console hosting in the United States.
LastPass utilizes Microsoft Azure US-East (Virginia) and US-West (California) for Identity Users hosting in the United States.
LastPass utilizes Amazon Web Services via EU-West-1 (Ireland) and EU-Central-1 (Germany) and EU-West-2 (United Kingdom) for Vault/Customer Content hosting in Europe.
LastPass utilizes Amazon Web Services via AP-South-1 (India), AP-Southeast-1 (Singapore) and AP-Southeast-2 (Australia) for Vault/Customer Content hosting in APAC.
LastPass utilizes Amazon Web Services via CA-Central-1 for Vault/Customer Content hosting in Canada.
LastPass uses Akamai Technologies, Inc. for Global Traffic Management (GTM) and DDoS protection services worldwide, though no Customer Content/Vault Data is stored by Akamai.
LastPass uses Amplitude Inc. for Product Performance Analytics in the United States.
LastPass uses CyberSource Corporation for Export compliance and Fraud Prevention System in the United States.
LastPass uses DataBricks, Inc. for Cloud Data Platform in the United States.
LastPass uses DataDog, Inc. for Observability platform used for cloud application monitoring, logging, and analytics in the United States.
LastPass uses PasswordPing, Ltd. for Customer Support and Communication in the United States.
LastPass uses Stripe, Inc. for Payment Processing in the United States.
LastPass uses Enzoic for user credential security web-monitoring (dark-web-monitoring) in the United States, Ireland, and Japan, if Dark Web Monitoring is enabled.
LastPass uses Pendo.io, Inc. for in-product messaging, user experience guide and onboarding platform in the United States, United Kingdom, and Israel.
LastPass uses Segment.io, Inc. for Data Governance Control Platform in the United States.
LastPass uses Splunk, Inc. for Security monitoring, logging, and analytics in the United States.
LastPass uses Twilio, Inc. for Accounts Receivable Customer Relationship Management System in the United States.
LastPass has expanded its global data footprint into India to better serve the APAC market.
LastPass servers are located in the US and in Europe, and users can choose which servers they use.
